name: What If
description: Imagining and wishing — what you would do in different situations, wishes and regrets, friendly advice, and dreamed-up futures.

description_localized.en: Imagining and wishing — what you would do in different situations, wishes and regrets, friendly advice, and dreamed-up futures.
description_localized.es: Imaginar y desear: qué harías en distintas situaciones, deseos y arrepentimientos, consejos entre amigos y futuros imaginados.
description_localized.fr: Imaginer et souhaiter : ce que tu ferais dans différentes situations, des souhaits et des regrets, des conseils entre amis et des avenirs rêvés.
description_localized.de: Sich Dinge vorstellen und wünschen — was du in verschiedenen Situationen tun würdest, Wünsche und Bedauern, freundliche Ratschläge und erträumte Zukünfte.
description_localized.pt-BR: Imaginar e desejar: o que você faria em diferentes situações, desejos e arrependimentos, conselhos entre amigos e futuros imaginados.
description_localized.ja: 想像して願う — さまざまな状況で自分ならどうするか、願いや後悔、友だちへの助言、そして思い描く未来。
description_localized.zh-Hans: 想象与愿望——在不同情境下你会怎么做、心愿与遗憾、朋友间的建议，以及畅想的未来。
